title: Decide whether letting go of a drag should land a measurement
goal: There are two ways to draw a distance measurement in the app: three clicks, which is what everyone gets, and one drag that lands the moment you let go, which is switched off. A walk in the repo tests the drag one and reports success while nothing at all was measured, so nobody can tell which of the two the product means. Pick one and make the walk say the truth.
notes: Reproduced 2026-09-08. Ran Scripts/playtest.sh Scripts/playtest/distance-lands-on-release.json against the probe build. Log at /tmp/photonz-playtest/distance-lands-on-release/log.json: step 8 drags (234,786)->(480,786) in distance mode and step 10 (stage 1-button-width, note "one drag, number placed by the app") reports measures=[]. The caliper is sitting in .secondPlaced waiting for a third click. Two separate causes: (a) Experiments measureDistanceLandsOnRelease is a sub-flag of next-measure-modes and is off, so CanvasMeasure.measureLandsOnRelease is false and advanceMeasurePlacement goes to .secondPlaced instead of committing; (b) the walk re-arms with a bare key i at step 11, which cycles the MODE rather than the tool, so stage 2 is actually measured in Size mode, not Distance, and that is the only reason the walk ends with any measurements at all. Use the measureMode step to arm a mode. The new measuring field in a walk log now names the in-flight state, which is how this was spotted.
acceptance: It is written down which way a distance measurement is meant to be drawn, and the app ships that way
Scripts/playtest/distance-lands-on-release.json either proves what it claims or is replaced by one that does
No walk in Scripts/playtest reports a measurement in a stage where its own log shows none

log.note: Adversarial review, before touching anything: the question was already answered. Decision card a-distance-measurement-can-be-one-drag-instead-o-should-a-distance-measurement-fi resolved 2026-09-02 with choice "keep" (Keep the three clicks), which carries declines:true, and the originating task was dropped as declined. So no new decision card. What was left undone on 2026-09-02 was the cleanup: the declined gesture stayed shipped behind the distance-on-release switch, with its own walk, which is exactly why nobody could tell which way the product meant.

Retired the declined gesture rather than leaving a switch that offers it: removed the distance-on-release parameter from next-measure-modes (FeatureCatalog), Experiments.measureDistanceLandsOnRelease, CanvasMeasure.measureLandsOnRelease and its early-commit branch, and the landsOnRelease: forms of MeasureToolMode.help/hint/keyTip and MeasureModeHint.detail. Distance is three clicks, one code path. The press-drag-release that draws the LINE is untouched; only the third click is now unconditional.

Added an expectMeasures step (PlaytestScript + harness, TDD in PlaytestScriptTests) so a walk can claim how many measurements are on the canvas and fail when it is wrong. The failure names what a half-placed caliper is waiting for. Verified it actually fires: a throwaway walk that drags and claims 1 failed with "0 measurements on the canvas, not 1; the caliper is both feet are down, waiting for a click to park the number".

Deleted Scripts/playtest/distance-lands-on-release.json (it walked the declined gesture). Rewrote distance-three-clicks.json to assert at every stage: 0 before, 0 after two clicks, 1 after the third, 2 at the end. Ran it on the probe: status ok, 123 px and 602 px both landed in Distance mode, real capture at three-clicks-sc.png.

Swept the other measure walks for the same unchecked claim: ran grab-cue, measure-readout-slide, measure-handback, measure-chip-snap, measure-lands-in-the-list, caliper-chip-join, measure-row-menu, caliper-catches-a-drawn-edge, snap-hold-foot, legend-corner-slots, guides-catch-marks on the probe (all ok) and cross-checked every hand-written describe stage against its own log's measures list. No stage claims a landed measurement while its log shows none. Two apparent hits were setup preambles before any measuring.

Written down in docs/design/next-measure.md: § 3 says Distance is three clicks and why the drag was turned down, § 10 gains row D6b recording the resolution. expectMeasures documented in docs/design/playtest-harness.md. Tests 4866 green.
